Arm Cannon Quirk.name: Arm Cannon Quirk
Arm Cannon Quirk.description:
💥 You turn one forearm into a cannon of bone and hardened muscle.

🌱 At the start you fire quick calcium rounds, or hold a glowing, whining charge that knocks an adult down from across a street.
📈 With training: door breaching, recoil jumps and fall braking, rescue ropes and grapple lines, blunt stun rounds, signal flares, a street-wide salvo.
⚠️ The cannon is useless for fine work until it turns back into a hand.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as stronger shots jar your shoulder and throw you backward.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Marksmanship +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Bore Snap, Braced Charge
Arm Cannon Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: one forearm (side fixed at creation) becomes a heavy bone-and-muscle cannon. A new adult user fires reserve-made calcium rounds about twenty meters, or a few-second charge that drops an adult across a street; special rounds and reach need training. Limits: no grip or fine work; reverting takes about three seconds. Straight shots can hit people beyond. Ropes, grapples, harnesses are carried gear. Quirk Strain: light: snap shot, flare; moderate: basic charge, rope launch, recoil jump, blunt round; heavy: breaching shot; severe: signature, sustained battery, awakened techniques. Type: Transformation (also fits Mutant). Law: outside self-defense or licensed duty, shooting people is assault, breaching property damage; strays are on the user. Look: a Mutant's forearm stays thick.
